# Ashish Kushwaha (AshishKingdom)

> Personal portfolio of Ashish Kushwaha, a Founding AI Engineer focused on agentic AI, backend systems, infrastructure, real-time voice AI, and low-latency retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

Ashish builds AI products and scalable backend systems. His recent work includes voice agents for telephony, AI workflows using open-source and commercial LLMs, and infrastructure for concurrent real-time calls. He is also an open-source contributor with interests in graphics programming, generative art, game development, and developer tools.

Canonical site: https://ashishkingdom.tech/

## Selected Projects

- [QB64 OpenGL Engine](https://github.com/AshishKingdom/QB64-OpenGL-Engine): An experimental open-world game engine built with QB64 and OpenGL.
- [p5js.bas](https://github.com/AshishKingdom/p5js.bas): A QB64 library inspired by p5.js, co-created with Fellippe Heitor.
- [Hunter's Revenge](https://github.com/AshishKingdom/Hunter-Revenge): A 2D pixel-art shooter game made with QB64.
- [aKFrameWork](https://github.com/AshishKingdom/aKFrameWork): A Windows-style GUI framework for QB64.
- [GUI Menu Bar](https://github.com/AshishKingdom/GUI-Menu-Bar): A GUI menu library for QB64.
